notes.title: Rise Eterna 2 is coming to Steam on October 9, 2025!
notes.content: [h2]We're excited to announce that Rise Eterna 2 launches October 9 on Steam![/h2][h3]War spares none. Athracia paid a heavy price while Ars Rare is barely recovering. In the middle of an uncertain peace rises Jacht - a young Athracian soldier tasked with a mission heavy with consequences.[/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Improving on the tactical RPG genre at the core of the first iteration, Rise Eterna 2 places you in the middle of an ongoing war between two families coveting the kingdom’s throne and one plotting its revenge. Set within an engaging setting, play as Jacht – a devoted Athracian soldier in a mission to reclaim the Empire’s lost glory and and destroy Lua's Heroes Army. Rise Eterna 2 includes:[/p][list][*][p]28 missions taking place across various locations and biomes combined with Strategic and Tactical combats challenging your decision-making skills[/p][/*][*][p]Terrains to use at your advantage! Depending on the type of tile units are standing on, their attacks or movement can be affected in different ways. Always try to catch the enemy at a disadvantage![/p][/*][*][p]A compelling recruitment and party organization system that lets you test various combinations and strategies at will![/p][/*][*][p]Customization with Gems: Choose from over 20 types of gems to enhance your heroes' abilities and weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill trees for each character with multiple factors including their own background affecting their skillset. Battle, evolve and unleash your skills in battle![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Rise Eterna War is available now!
notes.content:
Rise Eterna War tells the bloody tale of Arthbane, a great general who led the last stand to reclaim his homeland, Ars Rare, from foreign invaders. Play as Arthbane, a decade prior to the events of Rise Eterna, rallying loyalists in a desperate bid to seize the capital, Gaiacus.

Guide Arthbane's campaign against the occupying Athracian army, balancing strategy and resources to defeat cunning rival generals. Recruit up to 16 units and visit the Chuckwagon to feed your troops. Rally 11 legendary heroes - both new and returning favorites - and lead them to battle through over 40 missions.

With an emphasis on innovative fused gameplay, Rise Eterna War mixes real-time strategy, deck-building mechanics, and resource management. Immerse yourself in a dramatic, character-driven prequel revealing the inner demons of a complex antihero mourning the fall of his nation. Experience the precursor to a fabled resistance movement over hours of dark and emotionally charged storytelling.



[b]Game features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Blend of real-time strategy with deck building and resource management.
[*] Over 40 story-driven missions.
[*] 16 diverse units and 11 legendary heroes.
[*] Multiple levels of upgrades for your units and mounted ballista bolts.
[*] Resources Management system – buy meals and collect coins to feed and strengthen your forces.
[*] Emotional Storytelling.
[*] Dark and thought-provoking narrative.
[/list]
